days.title: 迪石 – 登岛
days.morning: About 2.5 hours by fast boat from Rach Gia port to Hon Lon.
days.afternoon: Check in, rent a motorbike and swim at Cay Men beach.
days.evening: Raw herring salad and steamed crab by the sea.

days.title: 灯塔 – 御滩
days.morning: Climb to Nam Du lighthouse for views over the archipelago.
days.afternoon: Ride around the island and swim at Ngu beach.

days.title: 乘船跳岛
days.morning: Hire a boat to Hon Mau and Hon Dau for fishing and snorkelling.
days.afternoon: Seafood lunch on a raft and a swim at Hon Mau.
days.evening: Back to Hon Lon for grilled seafood.

days.title: 古屯岛
days.morning: Take a small boat to Cu Tron island and its fishing village.
days.afternoon: Walk the pier and photograph the stilt houses by the sea.
days.evening: Buy dried squid and fish to take home.

days.title: 返回大陆
days.morning: Breakfast, then the boat back to Rach Gia.
days.afternoon: Look around Rach Gia, then on to Can Tho or Saigon.
